entries.zh: 到任；官员到达任所就职
entries.en: to take up one's office; to arrive and assume a post

entries.zh: 赴任；动身上任就职
entries.en: to set out for one's post; to go and take up office
entries.notes: 西语词头「tomar se de sin」拼写残损，义据汉字「赴任」与音写 hu xim 确定

entries.zh: 铨选、选授官职（「長選」具体所指未能确证）
entries.en: selection and appointment to office (uncertain term)
entries.notes: 「長選」非通行词目，西语词头残损难解（deuen 无法展开），仅据到任、赴任之后的铨选语境推断

entries.zh: 搵圣水；蘸取圣水（天主教礼仪中以指蘸圣水）
entries.en: to dip in (take) holy water
entries.notes: 「溫」当为「搵」（蘸）之借字，与西语 tomar agua bendita 相合；音写尾部另附读音 chuy'

entries.zh: 查后手；核账追查经手来源（查问钱货前一经手人）
entries.en: to check accounts; to trace the previous holder / examine who handled (money or goods) before

entries.zh: 抓一把；用手撮取一把
entries.en: to take (grab) a handful

entries.zh: 撮起来；用指尖撮取起来
entries.en: to pick up with the tips of the fingers; to pinch up

entries.zh: 撮一撮；用指尖撮取一下
entries.en: to take a pinch (with the fingertips)

entries.zh: 撮；用指尖撮取（一撮）
entries.en: to take a pinch; a pinch (taken with the fingertips)

entries.zh: 捐起来；捐集（钱款）起来，官府摊派或众人募集
entries.en: to raise (collect) money by contribution; to levy a subscription
entries.notes: 西语词头尾部「vn certalla~」缩略难展开，义据汉字「捐起来」与音写 chiang guy lay 确定

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕或为以手乱抓、乱撒（据音写 chiu loan sa 与残损词头推断，未能确证）
entries.en: 〔uncertain; damaged〕possibly to seize or scatter about wildly with the hand (uncertain)
entries.notes: 「手乱栅」字面不成义，西语词头残损（agenas、yenvo 无法展开），语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 出味；（食物）释出滋味
entries.en: to give out flavor; to release taste
entries.notes: 西语词头尾部「alog raue~」难解，义据汉字「出味」与音写 chut bi 确定

entries.zh: 翕汗；捂汗，以覆盖捂闷使身体出汗
entries.en: to sweat under cover; to work up a sweat by being wrapped up
entries.notes: 「翕」取捂盖义，与西语 tomar sudores（发汗）相合，并与下条「發汗」相别

entries.zh: 发汗；使出汗（亦指出汗，如服药、捂盖发汗）
entries.en: to induce sweating; to break out in a sweat

entries.zh: 阴司；阴间官府、冥司（掌核算生前善恶之所）
entries.en: the netherworld tribunal; the offices of the dead, where one's deeds are accounted in the afterlife
entries.notes: 西语词头前段残损，「la otra vida」（来世）与阴司互证

entries.zh: 阴府；冥府、地府（阴间衙署）
entries.en: the underworld; the netherworld court

entries.zh: 相带；相互连带、两物相附（相伴相随）
entries.en: to attach to / carry along with one another; to join two things together
entries.notes: 音写 sio hua 与「带」字对音不协，西语词头残损，据 juntar dos cosas（合二物）与「相带」字面推断

entries.zh: 露风；吹风乘凉，到户外纳凉
entries.en: to take the fresh air; to cool off in the breeze

entries.zh: 露冷；吹冷风、受寒
entries.en: to take the cold air; to be exposed to the cold

entries.zh: 露吹风；让风吹拂乘凉
entries.en: to let the wind blow on oneself; to take the cool air

entries.zh: 露吹冷；吹冷风受寒（音写尾部另附一句不可解）
entries.en: to take the cold wind; trailing phrase (I suy liam) unresolved
entries.notes: 音写尾部「I suy liam」无法对应成义，主句据汉字「露吹冷」与音写 lo chue chin 确定

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑为舡攤／舡欛（与船相关之物，或指泊靠、搭船之义，未能确证）
entries.en: 〔uncertain; damaged〕possibly mooring or taking of a ship (uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏本身标 [疑]（舡攤/舡欛两可），音写有 [残] 与污损（T99），语义无法确证
